hypothesis: Closed integer multiplication/bitwise reductions and ordered subtraction/FP reductions can compose with bounded affine fission, retained producer state and original producer stores. Original-control scheduling bounds scratch independently of the full-trip allocation, carrying the actual induction and termination result rather than treating an endpoint or equality witness as a count. This integrates both independently accepted heads without requiring original-loop vectorizability, pressure, chain-depth or reduction-count thresholds, or a new profitability model.
semantics:
Production is the union of the accepted implementations. Preserve finite representable bounds, constant nonzero affine induction steps, acyclic per-iteration producer CFGs, closed accumulator-use proofs, common participation, available live-outs and effect rejection. Ordinary original loads/stores remain together in their original blocks and order, including stores feeding the next iteration across a chunk boundary. Fresh nonescaping contribution allocas cannot alias original accesses. Unsupported calls, atomics, volatile accesses, strictfp/constrained FP and observable unsafe effects retain their rejection checks. A producer-visible recurrence remains producer-local; no moved accumulator may feed retained state, addresses, predicates or contributions.

Keep canonical N-base scheduling only where N is the actual entering count. Otherwise stop after original termination or C completed iterations, export the original continuation and actual next IV, consume K completed or P participating initialized slots, and resume only after consumption. 1<=K<=C and 0<=P<=K; P=0 bypasses the consumer without reading scratch. Simultaneous retained backedges, exact original seeds, neutral lanes, reduction carries, original branch polarity, tails and current/next/final live-outs remain checked. Subtraction clones accumulator-minus-contribution without normalization; multiplication clones flags, and only unflagged modular products use ordinary LV reassociation. The defined fixture uses c&1, so both nuw/nsw hold at every prefix for seeds 17 and -7. Strict ordinary FP and explicitly enabled fission reordering remain separate policies with no new fast-math, errno, alias or fenv assumptions. Exact fneg is retained and its direct stores are checked bitwise.

Certificates reuse the controller, state/result, compact-count, typed initializer, unique-definition, checked predecessor and consumer-induction helpers. Adapt the small VF4 schedule proof to actual SSA recurrences and dominating width definitions, preserving fixed width 4 versus scalable 4*vscale. Retain both heads' scalar-tail, seed/neutral/placement, carry, participation, scratch provenance and mutation-anchor obligations. New composed fixtures additionally bind actual vector finalizers through their updates, PHIs, exact carried initializers and typed private loads, and compare all remaining memory operations with the complete original block/order lists. No normalized replacement IR is executed.

Executable strategy is harness-only: freshly transform the exact six new original definitions, verify every original/uninstrumented/probed/specialized module, lower actual emitted scalar/fixed/scalable paths and compare entire states with exact original IR and a separate literal nonchunked C oracle. The oracle follows modular IV/current-or-next comparisons and original state/memory changes; it never substitutes N for original termination. Independent sign-bit operations implement fneg. Actual hooks check incoming IV/state, global/local producer ordinals, original continuation, every initialized scratch address/value and participant order, complete production before consumption, and actual vector/tail visits. Record exact producer/consumer/chunk/full/partial/empty/multi/zero/early/empty-then-active/final-inactive counters. Every mutation anchor and module splice is unique and nonidentical before rejection handling.
costs:
No new production analysis, profitability model, unbounded storage, rereads, duplication or alias guards. The existing capacity search takes at most 64 monotone iterations over unique streams, including ABI padding and index limits. Noncanonical chunks use original comparison plus a capacity comparison/and, actual-IV/continuation exports, a defined private-count freeze and outer continuation after consumption. Compact chunks add their existing P==0 guard; ordinary LV supplies its independent vector/tail dispatch. Retained state uses a bounded number of PHIs, not state arrays.

New mixed i32/double composition scratch is alignTo(4*C,8)+8*C: C=1/8/9/16 uses 16/96/112/192 bytes at ceilings 16/111/112/192, padding 4/0/4/0. Fifteen bytes cannot hold one padded slot. Scratch traffic is 12 stored plus 12 loaded bytes per participant, zero for empty compact chunks. Original traffic is 12 bytes loaded per completed iteration and 12 bytes written per participant (next i32 input and direct double fneg store), plus 60 bytes of final outputs per entered fixture; these are preserved accesses, not added fission traffic. Alias outputs overlap the inputs only as the originals permit.

Inherited multiplication i32/i64/i8 scratch remains alignTo(4*C,8)+9*C: C=1/8/9/65 costs 17/104/121/849 bytes, 13 stored plus 13 loaded bytes per participant. The 120-byte boundary selects C8/104; 16 still rejects. Inherited three-stream i32/double/float stores/subtraction/fneg use alignTo(4*C,8)+12*C: C1/8/9/16/64/65 costs 20/128/148/256/1024/1044 bytes, traffic 16+16 bytes per participant. One-stream analogous products remain 4*C and 4+4 bytes. Newly admitted native affine fixtures use these same capacity costs.

Production changes beyond both heads are conflict resolution and comments only. Composition adds finite fixture scans, one exact memory/fneg/vector wrapper, operation/shape parameters on existing small certificates, six regression functions, one lit driver and C oracle/probe accounting. Fixed/scalar functions execute once; scalable functions alone receive requested vscale repetitions. Emitted code and actual entries remain separate. Stack layout, machine traffic, pressure, spills, RVV execution and speedup are not measured.
limitations:
Worker invoked no compiler, cmake/ninja/make, opt/llc, test runner, executable checker, VectorizeTests, try.sh or primary evaluation. Only source/diff/frozen-record inspection, Python AST grammar parsing, static inventories/delimiter scans, JSON and whitespace review were performed. All current build/test/execution outcomes are pending the harness. Historical acceptance belongs to the separate heads and does not validate this merge. No Git history/index/refs, common checkout, compiler binaries, corpus inputs or external artifacts were changed.

Certificates deliberately recognize demonstrated fixture CFGs, VF4 shapes, limited initializer forms and a bounded LCSSA vocabulary, not arbitrary IR equivalence. Defined-flag multiplication and subtraction execute scalar consumers; wrapping multiplication additionally requests actual fixed/scalable consumers, with shape certified from emission. Current RISC-V scalable multiplication support remains a backend restriction; fixed emission must not count as scalable coverage. EVL/VP host execution remains unsupported, with inherited EVL code generation/machine verification separate. New composition FP inputs are finite signed-zero/cancellation cases; inherited raw-NaN/direct-negation matrices and their distinct subsequent-arithmetic comparison rules remain mandatory. Unsupported bounds, counter overflow, effects, feedback, incompatible participation, cyclic/early-exit CFGs and unavailable live-outs remain restricted. No target execution, performance gain, additional corpus selection or merged maturity is claimed.

The multiplication padded-budget case also selects C8/104 at its exact original location 52:3. Check actual original continuation/next-IV/completed counts and moved operations. Retain d1 connected vector/tail scratch GEPs and distinct consumer width names in the synthetic execution-checker IR. Resolve the textual conflict without duplicate SSA loads/increments from the older d2 template. This preserves correctness checks rather than deleting them.
